title: HDS notification/alert-cmc content.hds, conversation kinds
description: The hds block of a conversation alert: kinds, event ids, codes and counts only, never a value, a printed line, a name, a date, an item key or a stream id. The ids point into the relationship's own child of conversation-items, or at a document shared in it. See documentation/CONVERSATION.md.

oneOf.description: task-status (contact to person: the state of the work on one document. Alerts are immutable: the state is the latest by alert time, attempt breaking a tie.)

about.description: The event id of the document.

attempt.description: Attempt on this document, from 1: a label and a tie-break, never the order (a restarted contact may not know the last one).

counts.description: Counts only, never what was counted.

errorCode.description: With status error: a code, never a message.

oneOf.description: notice (contact to person: a message the app renders from its code. Never free text.)

about.description: The event id of the document, when the notice is about one.

oneOf.description: question (contact to person: a question event was written on the received child.)

eventId.description: The id of the question event (message/hds-conversation-v1) on the person's account.

about.description: The event id of the document the question is about.

oneOf.description: proposed-values (contact to person: proposed-value events for one document were written on the received child. A wake-up only: the person's app lists the child by about, never trusts count.)

about.description: The event id of the document.

count.description: How many proposed-value events were written for it in this batch.

oneOf.description: answer (person to contact: an answer event was written on the sent child.)

eventId.description: The id of the answer event (message/hds-conversation-v1) on the person's account.

inReplyTo.description: The id of the question or proposed-value event it answers.

about.description: The event id of the document.
